question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval controls become deliberately version-bound so a proposal revised after display must be reviewed again before apply, reject, or quarantine?
rationale: The implementation is mechanically coherent and preserves direct ID-only lifecycle calls, but whether existing pending approval controls should fail closed after revision is an operator-facing product and compatibility contract.

options.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
options.body: Accept the reviewed-version check for pending approval prompts while preserving direct Proposal-ID-only lifecycle calls as implemented.

options.title: Keep pending approvals ID-only
options.body: Retain the new review action but do not inject or require proposal versions for approval-mediated lifecycle controls.

options.title: Pause for narrower policy design
options.body: Defer the feature until an owner specifies whether stale approvals should reject, refresh automatically, or remain ID-only.

recommendation.title: Adopt version-bound approvals
recommendation.body: Accept the reviewed-version check for pending approval prompts while preserving direct Proposal-ID-only lifecycle calls as implemented.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the closest current-main approval-policy and before-tool-call behavior.
